children: Investors prefer companies to use their cash flow to improve their financial positions, according to 38% of respondents in the Bank of America global fund manager survey for September. A total of 33% of respondents would like companies to return cash to shareholders and 19% would like firms to improve capital spending, the survey shows. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
